title: Electrospun Fibrous Scaffolds of Poly(glycerol-dodecanedioate) for Engineering Neural Tissues From Mouse Embryonic Stem Cells
protocol: Cut the aluminum foil into a rectangular piece.
Fold the rectangular piece into a rectangular strip.
Attach the strip perpendicular to a flat metal plate with tape.
Mix glycerol and dodecanedioic acid in a 1:1 molar ratio in a beaker at 120 °C for 100 hr to obtain PGD polymer.
Dissolve poly(ethylene oxide) (PEO) and gelatin in 65% ethanol with a weight ratio of 1.5:3:95.5 in a 15 ml tube.
Tighten the cap and heat the mixture in an oven at 60 °C for 1 hr with stirring until it becomes a homogeneous solution (basal solution).
Mix the PGD polymer and the basal solution in a 4:6 weight ratio.
Add 0.1% riboflavin to the polymeric solution.
Mix well.
Feed the polymeric solution into a 5 ml standard syringe with an 18 G blunted stainless steel needle.
Insert the syringe into a syringe pump.
Attach the grounded lead of a high voltage power source to the metal plate.
Attach the positively charged lead to the needle.
Adjust the distance between the needle and the aluminum foil strip to 15 cm.
Place the syringe pump at an angle of about 15° with the horizontal.
Adjust the flow rate of the syringe pump to 0.6 ml/hr.
Set the operating voltage of the high voltage power source to 14.6 kV.
Expose the fiber mat to UV light for 60 min for cross-linking.
Transfer the fiber mat from the aluminum foil strip to a 100 mm Petri dish.
Expose the fiber mat in the Petri dish to UV light for another 20 min for sterilization.
Cut the fiber mat into round pieces of the same size with a surgical blade in a biosafety cabinet.
Place the cut fiber pieces into a 24-well plate.
Immerse fiber samples in 1 ml of phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and incubate at 37 °C overnight.
Aspirate PBS carefully from each well on the following day.
Add 1 ml of differentiation medium to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 3 hr.
Aspirate differentiation medium carefully after 3 hours.
Add 0.2 ml of matrigel to each fiber sample and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.
Alternatively, add 0.2 ml of 20 µg/ml laminin to the fiber and incubate at room temperature for 3 hr.
Carefully remove excess matrigel from each well after incubation.
Rinse each well with 2 ml of differentiation medium once.
Add 1 ml of Accutase to the mES cell culture dish and incubate for 10 min at 37 °C.
Collect detached mES cells into a 15 ml tube.
Pipette cells up and down about 15 times to break colonies.
Centrifuge cells at 400 x g for 5 min.
Resuspend cells in 4 ml of differentiation medium.
Transfer 200 μl of cell suspension into a 15 ml tube.
Dilute cell suspension 10x with differentiation medium.
Transfer 15 μl of diluted cell suspension to the hemocytometer chamber under the cover-slip.
Count cells in the 1 mm center square and four corner squares of the hemocytometer.
Calculate cell concentration using average count per square, dilution factor, and multiplication by 10^4.
Place approximately 5 x 10^4 mES cells onto each well.
Slowly drop cell suspension onto the middle of fiber samples in wells.
Add 1 ml of differentiation medium to each well.
Incubate plate at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for attachment, growth, and differentiation.
Aspirate old medium from each well every other day.
Replace aspirated medium with 1 ml of fresh differentiation medium.
Mix 1/10th volume of Resazurin fluorescence reagent with culture medium.
Add 1 ml of mixed solution to each well for cell viability assessment.
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 4 hr, protected from direct light.
Transfer 100 µl of reagent from each well to a 96-well plate three times.
Measure the samples on a fluorescence spectrophotometer using 560EX nm/590EM filter settings.
Add lysis buffer to the samples after 14 days of culture.
Isolate total RNA from the cells on fiber samples.
Use 4 µl of total RNA to synthesize cDNA in a 20 µl reaction scale by reverse transcription.
Prepare the PCR reaction mixture: add 10 µl Master Mix, 0.2 µl dye, 8 µl Nuclease-Free water, 1 µl cDNA, and 1 µl primer.
Set up the PCR program with an initial denaturation at 95 °C for 2:20 min.
Denature at 95 °C for 3 sec followed by annealing at 60°C for 1 min, repeat for 40 cycles.
Perform a final extension at 60° C for 1 min.
Analyze the real-time PCR results with StepOne software.
Export the results to Excel.
